reuse.why: Uses the existing extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags for tag parsing and extends the existing getMonthWideTargetCategories that every month-wide action already calls.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is added once, in the shared selection function; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule lives in the category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts that already decides which categories month-wide actions may touch.

scope.why: One function changed plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, commented, single point of truth; the group-notes join is explicit and tag parsing is shared.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the N-month averages all take their categories from getMonthWideTargetCategories.

one_place.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action.
